days.blurb: Touchdown in Munich, then the coach rolls into Bohemia. Prague Castle and Charles Bridge at golden hour, and our first night at the NH Prague City.
days.title: Munich to Prague

days.blurb: A free day to wander: the Jewish Quarter, gelato in 6°C weather, a boat under Charles Bridge, Kampa Island, and cake at Café Savoy.
days.title: Prague Free Day

days.blurb: Dresden rebuilt stone by stone, then the Bastei Bridge high above the Elbe — a fantasy realm in the mist — and on to Berlin as the city lights come on.
days.title: Dresden to Berlin

days.blurb: The Berlin Wall, Checkpoint Charlie and the Brandenburg Gate in the morning; golden Silesian fields through the coach window, and Wrocław's storybook square at dusk.
days.title: Berlin to Wrocław

days.blurb: A treasure hunt for Wrocław's little bronze dwarfs, the padlocked bridge to Cathedral Island, and Kraków's great medieval square under the lanterns.
days.title: Wrocław to Kraków

days.blurb: A quiet morning of remembrance at Auschwitz-Birkenau, then deep underground to the salt chapels of Wieliczka — a day of contrasts, held gently.
days.title: Kraków Memorial & Salt Mine

days.blurb: Across the High Tatras and Slovakia to Budapest, on the Danube.
days.title: Kraków to Budapest

days.blurb: Budapest in a day, and an evening cruise on the Danube.
days.title: Budapest

days.blurb: Parndorf outlet village, then Schönbrunn Palace and Vienna.
days.title: Parndorf & Vienna

days.blurb: The lakeside village of Hallstatt, then Mozart's Salzburg.
days.title: Hallstatt & Salzburg

days.blurb: The fairytale castle of Neuschwanstein, and back to Munich.
days.title: Neuschwanstein & Munich

days.blurb: One last morning in Munich, then homeward on SQ327.
days.title: Munich Departure

days.blurb: Home again, with thirteen days of stories to tell.
days.title: Arrive Singapore

trips.dedication: Dedicated to Christmin — my love, my travelling companion.

music.note: Chopin, Poland's own composer, in waltz time — the dance of Vienna, heard all the way across the trip.
music.title: Waltz in C-sharp minor, Op. 64 No. 2

trips.route: Munich · Prague · Dresden · Berlin · Wrocław · Kraków · Budapest · Vienna · Salzburg · Munich
trips.subtitle: A cartoon journey in thirteen days
trips.title: Highlights of Eastern Europe
